claim:draft.text: I am requesting a refund for my Core yearly subscription purchased on 2026-09-30 for 23500 cents (USD). Per your refund policy, subscription payments may be refunded within 30 days of purchase. I am within this eligibility window and am requesting a refund of the subscription fee only.

citations.title: Am I eligible for a refund? | Replit
citations.excerpt: You may be able to get a refund for a subscription payment. Subscription payments may be refunded within 30 days of purchase. For a monthly subscription, only the latest payment may qualify. A yearly subscription cannot be refunded after 30 days. Agent and AI usage charges, and domain purchases, cannot be refunded.
